Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent work experience
Experience working with stakeholders across multiple IT systems and teams within a large enterprise
Experience establishing a modern data enterprise solution ingesting and integrating data from multiple heterogenous sources with advanced analytics capabilities (e.g., NLP, ML)
Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation within a centralized code repository and database modeling tools
3+ years of hands-on experience in pipeline orchestration tools, logging, monitoring & alerting, troubleshooting, and automated testing & deployments (CI/CD), preferably using AWS services
Cumulative 5+ years hands-on experience with Data Pipelines, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, and Data Systems Integration

The incumbent will be responsible for leading the technical strategy, design, development, and implementation of a scalable, cloud-based, data and analytics platform for the UCI Health enterprise. The incumbent will work on a multidisciplinary team of developers within the Enterprise Data and Analytics Department and IT and will collaborate with other institutions across the University of California Health in order to support the UCI Health enterprise vision. The incumbent will administer, implement, and manage the platform solution to facilitate the effective use of UCI Health data for current and future needs. Initial projects will include the design and implementation of an infrastructure migration to AWS along with future expansion of the data platform for dynamic reporting and advanced analytics capabilities.
Strong track record of successfully leading the technical strategy, design, development, implementation, and maintenance of Enterprise Data Solutions
Proficiency in Python and SQL
Comfortable managing multiple projects at the same time
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work in agile team structure
Deep understanding of Big Data solutions architecture and management including establishing best practices and processes
Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, cost-efficient, and cohesive data solutions
